title: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination
paragraphs: We reviewed the claim submitted by Meadowbrook Physical Therapy under your health plan for services provided on September 21, 2026. After review, we are unable to approve payment.
Because you are currently receiving inpatient care, this request was handled as an expedited concurrent review.

Reason for denial: The continued inpatient rehabilitation stay is not medically necessary. Our clinical guideline TAM-CAR-201 requires documentation of conservative treatment before this service, and the records submitted do not show it. Reason code: CO-50.
The plan paid $0.00 of the $21,280.20 billed. The amount you may owe the provider is $21,280.20.

appeal.heading: Your Right to Appeal
appeal.text: You or your authorized representative may file a written appeal within 180 days of the date you receive this notice. Send it to Tamsin Health Partners, Appeals Unit, PO Box 21246, Savannah, GA 31401. If waiting for a standard decision could seriously harm your health, you may ask for an expedited appeal by calling 1-800-555-6913.
appeal.external: After the internal appeal, you may have the right to an independent external review. Free help is available from your state's consumer assistance program.
